research_basis.variant: Q_25x4|M0: 25% at each of TP1-TP4, original SL (M0), no break-even
research_basis.result_OOS_E2: n=73, mean +0.00R, 95% CI [-0.37, +0.42], PF 1.01, closed max DD 16.3R, block-bootstrap p95 DD 32.6R, drop-top-5 mean -0.32R

recommendations.sizing_note: 0.5% risk on a 4-way split needs at least 0.04 lots for an exact split. The median 5 USD stop at 0.5% risk gives 0.04 lots from about 4,000 USD equity (research B3). Below that, the split collapses under merge_into_next and fewer checkpoints run than the research variant assumed.
recommendations.approximation: The research split is exact. The runtime merges an undersized checkpoint into the next one and records a warning, so at small volumes this is a different exit schedule. How the research handled infeasible splits is not stated in the files read.
known_gaps: Same unresolved items as the conservative draft: broker symbol placeholder, unverified account and contract specs, untested edits, MID cost definition, and the concurrency skip (max_concurrent_positions 1).
Spread gate 1.0 is above default safety max_spread_price 0.5. The profile is refused until the owner raises the safety value to at least 1.0.
activation_blockers: Set symbols[0].broker_symbol to the exact Market Watch name.
Owner decision on settings/default.safety.max_spread_price (needs at least 1.0 for this profile).
Verify equity and contract specs. This variant needs at least about 4,000 USD equity to avoid the merge.
Owner review and explicit authorization to approve and activate.
recommendations.forward_test_advice: Demo or paper only, with owner authorization. Not preferred over the conservative draft: the research gives no evidence that the split beats a single TP4 exit, and its in-sample and OOS results sit at zero.
recommendations.audit_warning: AUDIT WARNING (independent audit, exploratory, 2026-10): the positive OOS mean of this research family comes entirely from signals whose text was edited MORE than 5 minutes after posting (about 25% of signals; 80% of them already had TP1 touched before the edit). Among signals whose text was stable within 5 minutes (about 75%), modeled mean R is NEGATIVE for every tested exit (MID costs, E2: 100% TP1 -0.31R n=283; S_TP4|M0 -0.22R n=225; S_TP4|M5 -0.25R n=225). Original pre-edit levels are unrecoverable, so late edits may embed hindsight. Treat this profile as having NO demonstrated edge; it exists only as a documented, fail-closed research artifact. UPDATE 2026-10-24: a second out-of-sample test (58 signals, 2026-09-24..2026-10-22) gave -0.66R for this exact candidate (E2, MID costs, n=53, CI [-0.79,-0.52]); the earlier +0.20R did not replicate. Use only for an operations test on the demo account, with no profit expectation. See OOS2_AND_LIVE_CROSSCHECK.md.
